transcript:
Agent: Thank you for calling Nimbus Telecom. My name is Ravi. How can I help you today?
Customer: Hi Ravi, I'm calling because my internet connection has been dropping constantly for the last three days. It's incredibly frustrating.
Agent: I am sorry to hear that you are experiencing these connectivity issues. I can certainly look into this for you.
Customer: I just want this fixed or I'm leaving.
Agent: I understand. Before we dive into the account details, could you please provide your account number and full name?
Customer: My name is Sneha Nair and my account number is 24040355.
Agent: Thank you, Ms. Nair. I'm checking the network status in your area. It seems there is some instability in the local exchange, but I cannot see any specific outage reported yet.
Customer: Instability? I can't work from home. This is unacceptable. I'm thinking about switching to another provider who actually provides a stable connection.
Agent: I would hate to see you go. Let me try to reset the connection from my end, but I'm not sure if that will solve the root cause.
Customer: I've already tried restarting the router three times. I'm tired of this. Just cancel my service entirely.
Agent: I can start the cancellation process for you, but I'll need to verify your email address on file to proceed.
Customer: It's sneha.78@examplemail.com and my phone number is 97228 17163.
Agent: Thank you. I have noted your request to cancel the account. I will pass this to the retention team for processing.
Customer: This is a joke. You haven't fixed the network and now you're just passing me to another team. I am absolutely disgusted with this service!
Agent: I apologize for the frustration. Is there anything else I can assist you with today? I've noted the cancellation request and the network issue. Goodbye.
